notes.title: Greetings, Champion! Release Day Approaches! (NEW TRAILER!!)
notes.content: [h2][i]We have an exciting dispatch from the developers of Dragon Front: Adventures - for your eyes only! [/i][/h2][p][i]Last time we posted, we reported that DFA was in its final phase of development, and we were preparing for a full launch of the game in the near future. We are writing now to inform you that we will be releasing soon. So soon, in fact, that we are looking at a launch date of [b]EARLY SEPTEMBER![/b][/i][/p][p][i] To celebrate this news, we have decided to upload a new trailer for your enjoyment, but we have one mission for you in return... [/i][/p][p][i]We want [b]YOU[/b] – to [b]WISHLIST NOW[/b]...so that you are notified the moment the game is released, and you can start your adventure![/i][/p]

notes.title: The Countdown Begins
notes.content:
The battlefield is shifting, and the time for sneak peeks has come to an end. Dragonfront Adventures is entering its final phase before launch, and to prepare for the grand unveiling, we’ve officially removed the demo from Steam.

We hope you had the chance to unlock the preview champions—they’ll be battle-ready when the full game arrives! With six diverse factions at launch, each boasting four fully playable champions, the ultimate strategic showdown is just around the corner.

Now, we sharpen our blades, sound the war horns, and make the final preparations. The adventure is coming—get ready!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174075/e41d19fd0753823f8562bda58b7d7433d8fd378b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Demo Walkthrough
notes.content:
Chris gives out some techniques to playing Dragon Front: Adventures Demo. The Demo has one champion unlocked and allows you to make progress that can transfer to the main game towards unlocking another champion. 

In the Demo, you get to play the starter Champion and journey through the Eclipse landscape. But be careful, you may be ambushed by a Thorns portal. The trader is waiting for you, to help upgrade your deck and along the way you can discover quests, with powerful awards.

notes.title: Dragon Front: Adventures AMA
notes.content: We're going live on Steam today! Join our Producer Chris Franz and our Design Director Micah Skaritka at 7pm CDT as we show off the Dragon Front: Adventures demo, available for download now.  https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2952180/view/4513261260721664830

notes.title: Producer Demo Playthrough (pre-recorded)
notes.content: [b]Chris[/b] is practicing so he doesn't embarrass himself when he plays live Thursday 7pm CDT. [b]Micah[/b] will be available to answer questions at that time.

notes.title: HVS Plays Dragon Front: Adventures!
notes.content: Catch our fearless Producer, [b]Chris Franz[/b], playing through the demo of Dragon Front: Adventures on Thursday the 17th at 7pm CDT. Chris will be diving into the core gameplay of DF:A and our Design Director, [b]Micah Skaritka[/b], will be fielding questions from the chat! Join us as we show off just a portion of the content we have planned for the full game. Early Access will be coming late Q4/early Q5, Wishlist today!

notes.title: Dragon Front: Adventures Demo - Patch 2
notes.content:
Greetings Intrepid Adventurers,

Patch 2 for the Dragon Front: Adventures Demo is now live!  This is a broad range of general quality of life improvements to improve your excursions into Terrene Gall.

[b]Addressed Issues:
[/b][list]
[*]Removed Trailer from defeat screen. 
[*]Allow Officer Keyring relic to be activated using Controller while hovering over an existing chest. 
[*]Improved functionality of controller on rewards screen.  
[*]Improved functionality of controller on Champion select screen. 
[*]Fixed a softlock that can happen if the deck list is brought up at the beginning of the battle victory sequence. 
[*]Fix for backing out of options menu, Trader, and Campfire screens with controller. 
[*]Tribe banner text no longer shows up on hovered last played cards if card does not have a Tribe. 
[/list]

notes.title: Dragon Front: Adventures Demo - Patch 1
notes.content:
Greetings Intrepid Adventurers,

Patch 1 for the Dragon Front: Adventures Demo is now live!  This is a broad range of general quality of life improvements to improve your excursions into Terrene Gall.

[b]Addressed Issues:
[/b][list]
[*]Addressed an AMD GPU out of Memory crash.
[*]Default Graphical quality and shadows is now set to medium.
[*]Improved the transition from Faction Select to Champion Select.
[*]Unavailable factions are now correctly locked on the faction select.
[*]In-game trailer has been updated.
[*]The trailer video is now skippable with Start/Esc.
[*]Addressed various typos.
[*]Banners for earlier battles now start with 5 health.
[*]Fixes boss positioning on Region Map.
[*]Fixed return to map button not showing hover visual correctly.
[*]Addressed issues with various visual effects.
[*]Abandon run prompt now properly updates.
[*]Unreal logo now fades properly with the text.
[/list]
[b]Known Issue Being Investigated:
[/b][list]
[*]There is a blue tint to Thorns Portal battles on Medium and Low settings. As a work around, changing the shadow quality back and forth will clear the blue tint.  
[/list]

notes.title: Dragon Front: Adventures Demo is Live!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Champions of Dragon Front!
[/b]
We’re beyond excited to unveil a sneak peek of our all-new roguelike deckbuilding experience, “[i]Dragon Front Adventures[/i]” in this year’s Steam Next Fest Demo! Take up arms as [b]Bromell[/b], a tactical mastermind from the Scales faction, and brave the chilling, undead landscapes of [b]Eclipse[/b]. With every battle, every card drawn, and each choice you make, you’ll edge closer to victory against one of four brutal bosses. But remember, this isn’t just about winning — it’s about mastering your deck and adapting to every challenge thrown your way! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174075/e67db74246a998497cfc5532f87103d0fa019fc9.gif[/img]

In the full game, each run takes you through three randomized regions, ramping up the difficulty with every turn. Unlock new Champions by completing special challenges, and experiment with their unique starter decks and abilities. Even in the demo, you’ll have a chance to unlock two additional Champions, preparing you for the Early Access version. 

Roguelike fans, your strategy and quick thinking are needed now more than ever. Join our [url= https://discord.gg/t2MSSnKX]Discord[/url], share your insights, and help us craft the ultimate deck-building journey as we head toward Early Release. 

Every run is a new story. Will you survive long enough to tell yours?
